item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Coarsely ground gourmet pork sausages with wild garlic, served with red wine and onion sauce and creamy mashed potato. Served with an apple and fennel salad with mustard vinaigrette. The dish is gluten free. (6+11+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Spicy chilli con chicken, served on rice and topped with crushed tortilla chips tossed with chopped parsley. Served with creamy coleslaw, lime and coriander. The dish is gluten free. (2+6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Spicy chilli con pea protein, served on rice and topped with crushed tortilla chips tossed with chopped parsley. Served with creamy coleslaw, lime and coriander. The dish is gluten free. (2+6+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Nepali-style chicken korma, served with rice, finely sliced spring onion and salted peanuts. (4+6+8+9+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Nepali-style tofu korma, served with rice, finely sliced spring onion and salted peanuts. (4+6+7+8+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Beef stroganoff with bacon. Served with buttery mashed potato. (6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Lentil and mushroom stroganoff. Served with buttery mashed potato. (6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Tuscan chicken, pan-fried chicken breast on mashed potato, topped with a creamy sauce of sun-dried tomatoes, spinach and a sprinkle of parmesan. Served with chilli sauce and blanched green beans tossed in cold-pressed butter-flavoured rapeseed oil and roasted garlic. Gluten free, and also available dairy free. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tuscan chickpeas, Italian-spiced chickpeas on mashed potato, topped with a creamy sauce of sun-dried tomatoes, spinach and a sprinkle of parmesan. Served with chilli sauce and blanched green beans tossed in cold-pressed butter-flavoured rapeseed oil and roasted garlic. Gluten free, and also available dairy free, which makes it vegan. (6+15)
